findings.problem: The exploratory --as-pid-1 combination left descendants alive after parent death.
findings.repair: Keep default bwrap reaper, bind the parse child to API parent lifetime, explicitly terminate/wait process group.
findings.evidence: M2.3-sandbox-preflight/receipt.json; production security and lifecycle coverage in M2.3-exact-python.log.

findings.problem: Clearing only the final sandbox environment did not establish that monitor/reaper environment was safe.
findings.repair: Launch prlimit/bwrap with a fixed minimal environment; test synthetic canary absent from both parser env and /proc/1/environ.

findings.problem: Runtime library source paths could recreate host directory names inside sandbox.
findings.repair: Mount required libraries under /runtime/lib, retaining only necessary ELF interpreter aliases; no host home/data mounted.

findings.problem: Invalid outer shapes and oversized diagnostic collections needed explicit protocol rejection.
findings.repair: Strict JSON validation rejects duplicate keys/extra fields, malformed values and more than501 diagnostics before admitting a candidate.

findings.problem: Extracted HTML-like text, entities and TeX-like strings must remain literal through Markdown rendering.
findings.repair: Escape literal punctuation/entities and render real PDF/DOCX text in tests; no active tags/links/math inference.

findings.problem: Initial checkerboard and1px image did not actually represent the image-formula acceptance scenario.
findings.repair: Original72x48 pixel x-squared formula embedded as pixels in both PDF and PNG/DOCX; originalPDF page2 rendered and visually inspected.

findings.problem: Direct hidden-run filtering missed inherited/default styles; ContentTypes and unknown member-name projection also needed strict checks.
findings.repair: Discover XML by ContentTypes Override/Default and resolved critical relationships; reject unsupported hidden styles. Eight negative regression cases changed from actual fail to pass; original independent production-sandbox probe now rejects without candidate or hidden diagnostic text.

findings.problem: Exact-only locator matching dropped table-level warnings from cell drafts.
